title: US Envoys Head To Kyiv After Stop In Moscow, Late-Night Meeting With Putin
content: After a day of crucial meetings in Moscow, including with President Vladimir Putin, US envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner are switching wartime venues, heading to Kyiv for talks with Ukrainian leader Volodymyr Zelenskyy with aims of ending the conflict now in its fifth year.

title: 'Apocalyptic Scenes' In Druzhkivka As Ukrainian Civilians Struggle To Leave

title: Blinded By Iranian Security Forces, A Protester Now Faces The Death Sentence
content: An Iranian man was blinded by security forces during the mass nationwide Women, Life, Freedom protests in 2022. He fled the country but then returned and has now been sentenced to death by hanging.

title: How Much Can Ukraine Disrupt Civilian Flights In Russia?
